newsitem.title: ALBANIA: Drunk's slip causes blast, killing three Albanians.
newsitem.headline: Drunk's slip causes blast, killing three Albanians.

text.p: Three people were killed and 10 wounded when a drunken man carrying a grenade tripped as he got onto a bus in a central Albanian town, causing an explosion, the state news agency ATA said on Tuesday.
The man, a local villager, was among the dead from Monday's blast at Rogozhine in the Kavaje district.
"His careless act resulted in him getting trapped in the bus door and the grenade exploding after the safety pin came off," ATA said.
"This caused the immediate death of three persons, one of them a woman. The grenade-carrying drunkard also died. Ten people were wounded, including the bus driver."
An estimated 700 people have died in Albania in the past three months, many accidentally, since state arsenals were looted of guns and explosives in widespread unrest.
Angry Albanians took to the streets to protest at the collapse of popular pyramid investment funds that erased the life savings of thousands of people.

Six days ago 27 people, including 12 children, were killed when an explosion ripped through an underground weapons store in a military base at Qafe Shtame, near Burrel, 95 km (59 miles) northwest of Tirana.
The victims were taking shell casings from the depot to sell when the blast occurred.
